reports.title: Patrick Industries, Inc. Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

guidance.heading: Business Outlook and Summary
section: “We continue to advance Patrick’s full-solutions vision by combining innovative products and components, differentiated technologies, and advanced manufacturing capabilities, even as the near-term demand environment remains uneven,” continued Mr. Nemeth. “The benefits of the expanded products and solutions we bring to our customers, in alignment with our engineering and design capabilities, are intended to compound over time and we believe they will enhance our financial performance while allowing for better partnerships with customers to help address product affordability for the end consumer. In addition, we are investing in engineering and emerging technologies, including prudent AI expenditures, that we expect will deepen our connection to the markets we serve, sharpen our ability to collaborate with OEM customers, and help shape the next generation of experiences for outdoor enthusiasts. As we begin to shift our focus to 2027, we remain excited about the value-added opportunity related to our pending all-stock merger with LCI Industries, which we believe will enhance our existing strategy and vision as well as the long-term value proposition for our customers, our team members, our shareholders, and the communities we serve. We are committed to being great partners to our customers and team members and good stewards to our markets and ecosystem. Finally, I want to thank our team members for their unwavering commitment to Patrick’s BETTER Together values and executing against our strategic initiatives, which we believe will drive long-term profitable growth and value for our stakeholders.”
1See additional information at the end of this release regarding non-GAAP financial measures.
